# connection-references commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `analyze` | Analyze flow-connection reference relationships (orphan detection) |
| `connections` | Show bound connection for a connection reference |
| `flows` | List flows that use a connection reference |
| `get` | Get a connection reference by logical name |
| `list` | List connection references |
